title: For corner lots
previewText:
M1 M2 M3

In all districts, as indicated, no primary business entrance, show window or sign shall be located on that portion of the street frontage of a corner lot within 75 feet of frontage on the same side of the street in a Residence District.

However, primary business entrances, show windows, or signs may be located on frontage less than 75 feet, but not less than 20 feet, from a Residence District boundary:

amendmentHistory.notes: Relocated provisions for non-illuminated signs to Section 42-632; relocated provisions of Section 42-442 – “For corner lots” -- here, title and text unchanged
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
